mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_customer_balance_account WHERE settlement_customer_id = #{settlementCustomerId} AND deleted = FALSE)

SELECT m.movement_no AS movementNo, m.type AS movementType, m.direction, m.amount, m.occurred_at AS occurredAt, so.order_no AS orderNo, COALESCE(own_refund.refund_no, allocation_refund.refund_no) AS refundNo, recharge.recharge_no AS rechargeNo, owned_return.id AS returnId FROM xsy_customer_balance_movement m JOIN xsy_customer_balance_account a ON a.id = m.account_id AND a.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_payment_intent intent ON m.source_type = 'PAYMENT_INTENT' AND intent.id = m.source_id AND intent.customer_id = #{customerId} AND intent.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND intent.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_payment_transaction recharge_tx ON m.source_type = 'PAYMENT_TRANSACTION' AND recharge_tx.id = m.source_id AND recharge_tx.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_payment_intent recharge_intent ON recharge_intent.id = recharge_tx.intent_id AND recharge_intent.source_type = 'BALANCE_RECHARGE' AND recharge_intent.customer_id = #{customerId} AND recharge_intent.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_customer_balance_recharge recharge ON recharge.id = recharge_intent.source_id AND recharge.customer_id = #{customerId} AND recharge.settlement_customer_id = #{settlementCustomerId} AND recharge.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_order_refund own_refund ON m.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND own_refund.id = m.source_id AND own_refund.customer_id = #{customerId} AND own_refund.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_refund_funding_allocation allocation ON m.source_type = 'REFUND_FUNDING_ALLOCATION' AND allocation.id = m.source_id AND allocation.customer_id = #{customerId} AND allocation.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_order_refund allocation_refund ON allocation_refund.id = allocation.order_refund_id AND allocation_refund.customer_id = #{customerId} AND allocation_refund.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_order_return owned_return ON owned_return.id = COALESCE(own_refund.return_id, allocation_refund.return_id) AND owned_return.customer_id = #{customerId} AND owned_return.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_sales_order so ON so.id = COALESCE(intent.source_id, own_refund.order_id, allocation_refund.order_id) AND so.customer_id = #{customerId} AND so.deleted = FALSE WHERE m.customer_id = #{customerId} AND m.settlement_customer_id = #{settlementCustomerId} AND a.settlement_customer_id = #{settlementCustomerId} AND m.deleted = FALSE AND m.type = #{type} AND m.direction = #{direction} ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC, m.id DESC

WITH own_receivables AS(
WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} AND so.customer_id = #{customerId} AND r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND r.deleted = FALSE) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(openAmount), 0) AS openReceivableAmount, MIN(dueDate) FILTER (WHERE openAmount > 0 AND dueDate < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) AS earliestOverdueDate, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.settlement_total_amount), 0) FROM xsy_sales_order o WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND o.deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_finance_receivable r WHERE r.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND r.source_id = o.id AND r.deleted = FALSE)) AS confirmedOrderAmount FROM own_receivables
